sourceRegistry.title: CaixaBank Expands Strategic Collaboration with Google Cloud to Accelerate AI and Data Capabilities
sourceRegistry.factSummary: CaixaBank announced an expanded agreement with Google Cloud and plans to deploy Gemini Enterprise. Document management and summarization are planned uses, not independently verified results.

sourceRegistry.title: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use
sourceRegistry.factSummary: Anthropic reported unintended model actions and said it was disabling live internet access for all internal evaluations until its safeguards and monitoring reliably catch such behavior. This does not describe an internet shutdown for every Claude customer.

sentences.english: Mona: Is there internet here?
Karim: No, the connection is down.
Mona: And is the program working?

sentences.text: كريم: أيوه، بس الصفحة مش بتفتح.
sentences.english: Karim: Yes, but the page is not opening.
sentences.transliteration: Kareem: aywa, bass es-safha mesh beteftah.

sentences.english: Mona: Okay, let us wait a bit.
Karim: Then we will try again.
Mona: Is there a connection now?
Karim: Yes, the internet is back.
Mona: Shall we try again?
Karim: Yes, I am ready.
Mona: The page opened!
Karim: Good, let us continue the work.

concepts.title: Is there a connection?
concepts.explanation: Fi means there is or there are. With question intonation it asks whether something exists. Mafeesh, written مفيش, means there is not or there are not. Hena places it here.

concepts.title: Working or not working
concepts.explanation: Use mesh before an adjective to negate a description: el-bernaameg mesh shaghghaal. Maʾtooʿ means disconnected or down for a connection. No separate present-tense “is” is needed. Do not confuse mafeesh (there is no) with mesh (not).

lessons.title: Hol van a másolat?
lessons.subtitle: October 11, 2026 · Where is the copy?
objectives: Find a file in this or that folder.
Distinguish an old version from a fresh copy.
Say you save a file and check its date.

readings.title: Plans for document tools · October 9 announcement

sentences.text: A CaixaBank bővíti az együttműködést a Google Clouddal.
sentences.english: CaixaBank is expanding its collaboration with Google Cloud.
The bank plans to use AI tools.

sentences.text: A cél a dokumentumok kezelése és összefoglalása.
sentences.english: The goal is managing and summarizing documents.
Anna: Where is the file?
Bence: In this folder.
Anna: Is this the old version?

sentences.text: Bence: Igen. Itt a friss másolat.
sentences.english: Bence: Yes. Here is the latest copy.
Anna: I will save the copy.

sentences.text: Bence: Jó, nézd meg a dátumot is!
sentences.english: Bence: Good, check the date too!
Anna: Which folder is it in?
Bence: In that folder.
Anna: Found it! The date is correct.
Bence: Will you open the file?
Anna: Yes. The copy is ready.
Bence: Then we can continue.

concepts.title: In this folder; in that folder
concepts.explanation: Use -ban or -ben for in. Mappa becomes mappában: final a lengthens to á. With this or that, the demonstrative also takes the ending: ebben a mappában, abban a mappában. Keep the article a between them.

concepts.title: Save a specific file
concepts.explanation: Elmentem is the complete first-person definite form for I save it in this context. A specific object takes -t: a fájlt, a másolatot. In Itt a friss másolat, the adjective precedes the noun and there is no separate is.
